comments.author: Bael
comments.body: If a rank 5 Reduce Vigour Consumption is 1 vigor per turn, then how much is a rank 6? Have anyone tested this?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Not me, but my guess is that 5 vigor skills still cost 1 vigor to use while higher vigor skill (Emergency Acceleration, cannon skills, etc.) cost less to use with R6 than they would with R5.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: But of course, silly me I forgot there are skills that consume more than 5 vigor
